## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- 基础分区过滤 (几乎所有查询使用)
WHERE tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_region = 'PH'           -- 或 'ID','SG','VN', etc.
  AND grass_date = date'2026-05-24'

-- 按 report_type 过滤
WHERE report_type = 0               -- Traffic (traffic_diff)
WHERE report_type = 1               -- Finance (finance_diff)
WHERE report_type IN (2, 3)         -- Attribution (attribution_diff / atc_diff)

-- Click/Impression 空值过滤 (traffic_diff 特有)
WHERE click_timestamp IS NULL AND imp_timestamp IS NULL

-- Debug 单条事件查询

  AND ads_id = 198651405
```

```sql
FROM (

      AND report_type = 1

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ... FROM mp_paidads.temp_dwd_event_performance_di__reg_s0_live
    WHERE tz_type = 'local' AND grass_region = 'PH' AND grass_date = date'2026-05-24'
      AND report_type = 1
) new ON old.join_key = new.join_key

-- 与 dwd_advertise_performance_di__reg_s0_live (旧表) 对比
SELECT ...
FROM mp_paidads.dwd_advertise_performance_di__reg_s0_live old
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.temp_dwd_event_performance_di__reg_s0_live new
  ON old.deduct_unique_id = new.deduct_unique_id
  AND old.ads_id = new.ads_id
  AND old.user_id = new.user_id
  AND old.entrance = new.entrance
WHERE abs(COALESCE(old.field, 0) - COALESCE(new.field, 0)) > 0
```

### 1. Write - 标准区域变体 (paidads_mart 单源)
```sql
-- 9 个区域变体 (VN, SG, TH, TW, MY, ID, MX, BR) 的模式
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE temp_dwd_event_performance_di__reg_s0_live
  PARTITION (tz_type='local', grass_region='${upper_region}', grass_date='${grass_date}')
SELECT /*+ BROADCAST(d),BROADCAST(e) */
    a.ads_id
    ,broad_gmv_amt_local, broad_item_cnt, broad_order_cnt
    ,expenditure_amt_local, click_cnt, impression_cnt
    ,expense_free_credit_with_expiry, expense_free_credit_without_expiry
    ,expense_paid_credit_with_expiry, expense_paid_credit_without_expiry
    ,order_cnt, checkout_cnt, ads_item_sold_cnt, ads_order_gmv_local
    ,paid_order_cnt, paid_order_gmv_local, paid_order_gmv_usd
    ,a.campaign_id, a.item_id, a.shop_id, a.placement, a.pricing_type
    ,entrance, sub_entrance, entrance_group
    ,coalesce(a.shop_id, c.shop_id) AS shop_id
    ,tag_ids, a.ta_group_id, ta_matched_tag_ids, ta_premium_rate
    ,expenditure_amt_local/exchange_rate AS expenditure_amt_usd
    ,case when source_type='traffic' then 0
          when source_type='finance' then 1
          when source_type='attribution' then if(order_status='ORDER_STATUS_PLACED',2,3)
     end AS report_type
    ,rapid_boost_toggle, rapid_boost_state, campaign_surge_toggle
    ,roi_upper_bound, is_ocpm, is_preselected_vmodel
    ...
FROM (
    SELECT ... FROM paidads_mart.dwd_event_performance_hi__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = '${upper_region}'
      AND regional_date >= date('${grass_date}')
      AND regional_date <= DATE_ADD(date('${grass_date}'), 1)
      AND DATE(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP(
          CONCAT(regional_date,' ',lpad(regional_hour,2,0),':00:00'), 'UTC+08:00'), '${timezone}'))
          = date('${grass_date}')
) a
LEFT JOIN dim c ON a.ads_id = c.ads_id
LEFT JOIN target_audience_info d ON a.campaign_id = d.campaign_id AND a.shop_id = d.shop_id AND a.ta_group_id = d.ta_group_id
LEFT JOIN exchange_rate_tab e ON a.grass_region = e.grass_region
```

### 4. Read - 新旧 item_price 对比
```sql
SELECT old.*, item_price_new
FROM (
    SELECT 'old' AS env, deduct_unique_id, ads_id, user_id, entrance,
        SUM(item_price) AS item_price_old
    FROM mp_paidads.dwd_advertise_performance_di__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = 'PH' AND grass_date = date'2026-05-24' AND report_type = 1
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
) old
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 'new' AS env, deduct_unique_id, ads_id, user_id, entrance,
        SUM(item_price) AS item_price_new
    FROM mp_paidads.temp_dwd_event_performance_di__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = 'PH' AND grass_date = date'2026-05-24' AND report_type = 1
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
) new ON old.deduct_unique_id = new.deduct_unique_id
  AND old.ads_id = new.ads_id AND old.user_id = new.user_id AND old.entrance = new.entrance
WHERE abs(COALESCE(item_price_old,0) - COALESCE(item_price_new,0)) > 0
LIMIT 10
```

```sql
  PARTITION (grass_region, grass_date, type)
```

```
        ├── mp_paidads.ods_log_ads_report_livestream_hi__reg_s0_live → livestream_report_ng

        ├── (same tables) → cpm_deduction_issue_fix
        ├── (same tables) → cpc_cps_deduction
        ├── mp_paidads.shopee_ads_{region}_{shard}__advertisement_tab (LEFT JOIN)
        ├── mp_paidads.shopee_ads_{region}_{shard}__target_audience_group_tab (LEFT JOIN)
        └── mp_order.dim_exchange_rate__reg_s0_live (LEFT JOIN)
```

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

从 INSERT SELECT 表达式中归纳（指标公式）：

| 派生列 | 公式 | 来源 |
|--------|------|------|
| expenditure_amt_usd | expenditure_amt_local / exchange_rate | 汇率换算 |
| ads_order_gmv_usd | ads_order_gmv_local / exchange_rate | 汇率换算 |
| broad_gmv_amt_usd | broad_gmv_amt_local / exchange_rate | 汇率换算 |
| paid_order_gmv_usd | paid_order_gmv_local_s / exchange_rate | 汇率换算 |
| imp_attr_order_gmv_usd | imp_attr_order_gmv / exchange_rate | 汇率换算 |
| paid_broad_gmv_usd | paid_broad_order_gmv / exchange_rate | 汇率换算 |
| no_click_gmv_usd | no_click_gmv / exchange_rate | 汇率换算 |
| agent_order_gmv_usd | agent_order_gmv / exchange_rate | 汇率换算 |
| event_datetime | from_unixtime(timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') | 时间格式化 |
| deduct_datetime | from_unixtime(deduct_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') | 时间格式化 |
| click_datetime | from_unixtime(click_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') | 时间格式化 |
| paid_datetime | from_unixtime(paid_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') | 时间格式化 |
| confirmed_datetime | from_unixtime(confirmed_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') | 时间格式化 |
| video_play_3s_cnt | IF(view_duration * 1.0 / 1000 >= 3, 1, 0) | 播放时长换算 |
| video_play_5s_cnt | IF(view_duration * 1.0 / 1000 >= 5, 1, 0) | 播放时长换算 |
| rapid_boost_toggle | (ad_attr_flags & 140737488355328) > 0 | Bitmask 判断 |
| rapid_boost_state | IF((ad_attr_flags & 4398046511104) > 0, 'cold start', 'mature') | Bitmask 判断 |
| campaign_surge_toggle | (ad_attr_flags & 2097152) > 0 | Bitmask 判断 |
| roi_upper_bound | CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(bid_rerank_trace, '$.idx_roi_upper_bound') AS DOUBLE) | JSON 提取 |
| report_type | CASE source_type WHEN 'traffic'→0 WHEN 'finance'→1 WHEN 'attribution'→IF(order_status='ORDER_STATUS_PLACED',2,3) END | 数据源映射 |
| is_ocpm | IF(is_ocpm=1, TRUE, FALSE) | Int→Boolean |
| order_item_has_spu_vmodel | IF(is_order_item_has_spu_vmodel=1, TRUE, FALSE) | Int→Boolean |
| is_preselected_vmodel | IF(is_preselected_vmodel=1, TRUE, FALSE) | Int→Boolean |
| expense_rebate_free_credit_without_expiry | CAST(ROUND(free_without_expiry_rebate_expense * 100000) AS BIGINT) | 金额精度换算 |
| target_cir | COALESCE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(cpm_detail.*_json_data, '$.target_cir')) | JSON 提取 (PH 多源) |
| item_price | COALESCE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(cpm_detail.*_json_data, '$.item_price')) | JSON 提取 (PH 多源) |
| ad_tag | COALESCE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(cpm_detail.*_json_data, '$.ad_tag')) | JSON 提取 (PH 多源) |
